crossRefs.note: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

people.name: Ish-bosheth
people.line: Son of Saul, king over Israel.

translations.web: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, even from Paltiel the son of Laish.
translations.bsb: So Ish-bosheth sent and took Michal from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
translations.kjv: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
translations.asv: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Paltiel the son of Laish.
